# Pixel Composer fixture

`Canvas.pxc` is the unmodified Canvas template from Pixel Composer at
commit `3045d4f49b0c59926784f59efc1728d528a337cb`. It contains a canvas
group, an embedded RGBA8 drawing, a composite layer, a group output, and
a saved 32 × 32 preview. The upstream MIT license is included alongside
the fixture. [Upstream file](https://github.com/Ttanasart-pt/Pixel-Composer/blob/3045d4f49b0c59926784f59efc1728d528a337cb/datasrc/Welcome%20files/Templates/Canvas.pxc)
